finalText:
Found it. `src/pricing/engine.js` was rounding the cart total to 2 decimals right after the percent coupon, before the flat coupon and currency conversion ran. That's an extra rounding step the math shouldn't have.

Most of the time it didn't matter, but for some baskets and currencies that early rounding nudged the number just enough to land a cent off after conversion. It only ever showed up with the percent coupon, and only in GBP, CAD, and JPY, which is why it looked random to Finance.

Fix: only round once, at the very end, in the order's own currency. All 40 tests pass now.
